title: WAVE I
label: New Polar Sound | Pulse Index
blurb: Static Channel's new album, released live at Pulse Index x Mindscape, Studio dB Berlin.
about:
Wave I is an improvised ambient electronic album born from a time of stillness - when
the usual rhythms of live performance fell away, and creation itself became a form of
connection. In these spacious moments, we turned to longform synth and bass guitar
improvisations, allowing each piece to unfold naturally, without expectation.
Later curated and shaped for emotional clarity, the recordings capture both the
immediacy of live creation and the quiet beauty of unexpected turns. It’s an album
that stretches time - where making becomes listening, and structure emerges through
presence.
Mixed by longtime collaborator Daphne Zoe Dahlia, Wave I highlights minimal textures
and narrative flow. It is the first of two companion albums from this period, each
paired with abstract visuals that drift between generative forms and fragmented
memories - dreamlike, tactile, and suspended just out of reach.
